title: The Mind Behind the Man
description: A vivid self-portrait of Luke Nathan Hayes told through one life, a 288-facet horn torus and the worlds connected to it.

title: The bloke before the blueprint
description: Meet the practical human behind the larger ideas through island life, work, travel, humour and the identities he uses in public.

title: I stopped accepting the default
description: Follow the early civic work and the period when Luke stopped accepting inherited systems as the only possible systems.

title: My Aura has 288 facets
description: Explore Luke's personal Aura through a horn torus whose facets connect body, mind, place, work, love, music, civics and future.

title: The machinery under the metaphor
description: Look beneath the Aura metaphor at its geometry, memory ideas, digital-twin designs, hardware paths and open engineering questions.

title: I sing the system before I build it
description: Enter the songs, comedy and story worlds Luke uses to feel, test and communicate systems before the technical language catches up.

title: Love is infrastructure too
description: A candid, non-explicit account of love, consent, non-monogamy, larger family possibilities and the personal hopes inside Luke's story worlds.

title: Start on the island
description: Begin on Minjerribah, where Luke's practical work, music, local prototypes and enormous future questions meet.

title: A fair go needs better machinery
description: From a purple toilet mat to civic ledgers and shared compute, explore Luke's proposals for making a fair go more practical.

title: Every border can become a bridge
description: Travel through India, Nepal and a wider world of invitations, hosts, useful work, art, relationships and cross-border tools.

title: From one Aura to a solar system
description: Follow Luke's widening path from one personal Aura through Oceania and Earth to the Sun, satellites and the questions beyond them.

title: Show me the receipts
description: Walk through Luke's open studio of old documents, live links, rough drafts, AI conversations, missing pieces and changing versions.

title: Why are you here?
description: Choose a short route through the same open story based on what brought you here, without hiding the rest of the site.

title: Complete site map
description: See every chapter and public project link in one clear map of The Mind Behind the Man.
